races.paceDynamic: Vincenzo Peruggia and Utmost Good Faith will clash from the gates in this small field, creating an honest gallop over Musselburgh's testing mile. With only six runners and two committed front-runners, there's nowhere to hide and the pace will be strong from flag to finish. The remaining four runners all possess hold-up tactics, meaning the early leaders will face sustained pressure in the closing stages. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will stretch the field and allow closers to time their challenges effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners engage in a pace duel through the first half mile
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for the quartet of hold-up horses who can sit off the pace and time their runs. Comic Hero with Oisin Murphy aboard and the well-handicapped Kanishka will benefit most from this race shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Vincenzo Peruggia or Utmost Good Faith gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left to hold off the closers, particularly if they can dictate terms without pressure. Utmost Good Faith's recent form edge gives him the better chance of executing this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Monoceros can track the leaders without getting involved in early pace battles
scenarios.body: The Iain Jardine-trained runner can use his prominent style to sit closer than the hold-up horses and strike when the leaders weaken. His 191-day break remains a concern but his class could tell.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners show early speed but fade dramatically in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between the hold-up horses with little pace bias. This would favour the highest-rated closer with the strongest finishing kick regardless of tactical positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Goldmoyne will set the pace uncontested from the front, creating a steady rhythm rather than fierce early fractions. Behind him, a dangerous log-jam develops with Midnight Gun, Golden Mind, Al Arbeed, Gweedore, Royal Zabeel, A War Eagle and Bellarchi all wanting prominent positions - seven horses fighting for space in the first half of the field. This congestion will cause interference and blocked runs turning for home, with several prominent runners getting shuffled back. This setup strongly favours the hold-up horses Persuasion and Jannas Journey who can avoid the early traffic and pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get tangled up in traffic 2-3 furlongs out as predicted
scenarios.body: The pace setters tire and the congested pack gets strung out, allowing the back markers to unleash telling late runs. Persuasion and Jannas Journey benefit most from clean runs while the scrimmagers pay for their positional battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Goldmoyne wires field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setter gets soft fractions and the prominent pack fails to organize a cohesive challenge
scenarios.body: His recent winning streak continues as he capitalizes on uncontested leadership and holds off a disjointed pursuit. The form horse proves class tells when given an easy lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the seven prominent runners can secure ideal position without getting caught in the squeeze
scenarios.body: They benefit from Goldmoyne's honest pace while avoiding the worst of the traffic problems that befall their rivals. Midnight Gun or Al Arbeed most likely to thread through cleanly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If Goldmoyne goes too slowly and the prominent pack settles behind without pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure speed matters most, negating the hold-up horses' tactical advantage. Golden Mind's recent winner form could prove decisive in a dash.

Persuasion has never won beyond 7f but soft ground record is excellent - trip and surface combination is ideal

races.paceDynamic: Roaring Legend will dictate from the front with no other natural leaders, likely setting a comfortable rhythm through the early stages. Al Qareem and Lady Vivian should track in second and third, with the trio of hold-up horses Mount Atlas, Kate O'Riley, and Many Men settled at the back. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can control the tempo, potentially quickening late when the closers make their move. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick — the tempo may not be strong enough to fully set up the race for the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Al Qareem or Lady Vivian can sit handy behind Roaring Legend's controlled pace
scenarios.body: The leaders dictate comfortable fractions before the prominent runners strike with superior class and fitness in the final two furlongs. Al Qareem's OR 114 and strong soft ground record gives him the edge over Lady Vivian's longer absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing in the middle stages
scenarios.body: Mount Atlas and Many Men benefit from a stronger gallop that stretches the field, allowing Oisin Murphy to time his challenge perfectly on the highest-rated closer. The extended trip suits both hold-up runners coming from off the speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Roaring Legend faces no serious pace pressure and can dictate throughout
scenarios.body: Jason Hart can control every sectional before unleashing a sustained drive, with the recent run fitness advantage proving decisive. The headgear change suggests connections expect improvement from this consistent performer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes a tactical affair with a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Kate O'Riley's recent Goodwood second shows she handles this trip well, and Cieren Fallon's booking for the in-form James Owen stable suggests confidence. A slowly-run race would negate the class advantage of the higher-rated rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Almuhit will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners in the field, setting a moderate pace over the extended 1m6f trip. Gambino and Sportingsilvermine may track him prominently in the early stages, but neither will apply serious pressure, allowing the leader to dictate fractions. The large field of predominantly hold-up horses will settle behind in a compact group before fanning wide in the straight. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the uncontested pace will be insufficient for the trip, leaving plenty in reserve for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Almuhit unchallenged early.
scenarios.body: The field will arrive in one piece turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish that suits the many talented closers. Horses like Shadow Dance, Wise Eagle and Moon Over Miami will have every chance to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Gambino or Sportingsilvermine take closer order and maintain strong galloping rhythm.
scenarios.body: These tactical speed horses can steal a march on the hold-up brigade by positioning closer to the pace without over-exerting. Their class and race-fitness could prove decisive if they avoid the late traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Almuhit gets an armchair ride and the field fails to organize a strong challenge.
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina and Sean Levey's tactical nous could see them maintain momentum when others struggle to close. Recent good form suggests he's capable of defying the hold-up horses if the pace scenario falls perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical crawl and turns into a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: Horses with tactical speed who can position handy and quicken sharply will have the edge over pure stayers. This would particularly suit those who've shown form over shorter trips recently.

watchPoints.text: Monitor early pace - if Gambino or Sportingsilvermine press Almuhit early, it could set up perfectly for the hold-up horses behind.

Observe Moon Over Miami's fitness after 358-day absence - any signs of rustiness early could rule out Ralph Beckett's charge.

The pace will be steady early but the prominent pack will create severe traffic problems turning for home as they fan out looking for racing room. This congested setup with one clear leader and multiple horses wanting the same tactical position strongly favours the two hold-up horses, Jer Batt and Vintage Clarets, who can avoid the early scrimmaging and pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets tangled up 2f out as predicted
scenarios.body: The early pace will be steady but the wall of prominent runners creates a traffic nightmare, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Jer Batt and Vintage Clarets benefit from cleaner passages and fresher legs.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: A horse like Against The Wind or Rhythm N Hooves manages to thread through the pack and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. The tactical positioning pays off with good timing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader lasts home
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma gets soft fractions and the pack doesn't organize
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead proves decisive as the prominent runners take too long to wind up their challenges. Democracy Dilemma has enough left in the tank to hold off late challengers.

scenarios.title: Sprint specialist strikes

races.paceDynamic: Thecoffeepoddotco is the clear early leader with several prominent racers including The Bell Conductor, Al Hussar, Pop Star, Curious Rover, and Ziggy's Triton likely to press forward from the gates. This creates a genuine gallop over the minimum trip, with the pace sustainable rather than frantic given only one confirmed front-runner. The strong contingent of hold-up horses including Wheels Of Fire, Montezuma, Zarzyni, Arnhem, Water Of Leith, Classy Al, and Woohoo will benefit from the honest tempo. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and those coming from off the pace will have plenty to aim at in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain a strong gallop throughout the 5f trip
scenarios.body: The genuine pace plays perfectly into the hands of the hold-up brigade who can pick off the leaders in the final furlong. Wheels Of Fire and Water Of Leith are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Group Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Thecoffeepoddotco and the prominent runners maintain their positions without folding
scenarios.body: The early leaders prove tough to pass despite the honest gallop, with Al Hussar's consistent 5f form and The Bell Conductor's experience telling. Class shows as the front group resist the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with tactical riding in the middle section
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with horses caught out of position, favouring those with tactical speed who can quicken when gaps appear. Pop Star and Curious Rover benefit from their versatile styles.
